'''Racer CGK-0''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] that was used in droid races on the [[Promenade]] of [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Grand Acquisitions Race]], a galaxy-wide scavenger hunt organized by the [[Chevin Conglomerate]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. [[Sapaaga]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] was a frequent better on the Promenade races and Racer CGK-0 was his favorite droid.
